policy: Only original composition/SFX and explicitly licensed render or voice resources may enter a released video. No reference-PV audio is an input.

resources.notes: Every note and rhythm is declared original; externalSourceFiles is empty.
Waveforms are generated from seeded equations. No recordings or sample packs are used.
